# Human MMP2 (P08253)
## UniProt Accession: P08253
## Full Name: Matrix metalloproteinase-2
## Organism: Homo sapiens (Human)
## Sequence:


## Manufacturer Information:
- **Enzo**: Produced in yeast. Active recombinant matrix metalloproteinase-2 (MMP-2, gelatinase A, 72kDa type IV collagenase) cloned from human cDNA. The enzyme consists of residues Tyr110-Asp452, which comprises the catalytic/fibronectin domain of human MMP-2, with a C-terminal purification tag.
